scope.inventory_boundary: All BDL/BMD members in these 18 fixed archives, plus one explicit stock-resource sharing row.
scope.outside_inventory: Other archives, material tables/animations, unused/debug/stage variants and actor-specific state need follow-up.
scope.owner_authorization: 2026-11-06: Proceed with asset expansion now despite remaining #149 acceptance gaps.

dynamic_exclusions.reason: Real effect lifetimes and texture/callback changes need separate scripted exercises.
Stock model draws exclude equipment/action-dependent material and model changes.
Actor AI, animation, damage and boss phases are not instantiated.
Scene model flags, actor/environment lighting, fog, water, shadows and layout-dependent paths are excluded.
Resource sharing does not exercise native menus, cutscenes or alternate-mode runtime state.
